title: Taqdīm al-ʿAql ʿalā l-Nafs
transliterated_title: Taqdīm al-ʿAql ʿalā l-Nafs (On Intellect's Superiority to the Soul)
genre: brief lettrist work on four positions on intellect and soul

date.basis: The entry gives no date; no copy in MS Majlis 10196; the earliest dated copy is 10th/16th (?) century.

addressee: not stated for the composition; one manuscript (Sipahsālār 2930/6) notes it was presented to a Dawlat-i Sayyidiyya-yi Imāmiyya-yi Rażaviyya (unidentified)
manuscript: MS Princeton 319 (1187) ff. 69b-70b (10th/16th (?)); MS Sipahsālār 2930/6 ff. 118b-121a (undated).
summary: A brief lettrist work setting out four views of how intellect stands to soul: those of the peripatetics, the illuminationists, the Sufis and the lettrists.
